                            Office of the City Clerk

                           Document Tracking Sheet




Meeting Date:                 2/26/2021
Sponsor(s):                   Cardenas (12)
Type:                         Ordinance
Title:                        Zoning Reclassification Map No. 6-1 at 2800-2830 S Troy St
Committee(s) Assignment:      Committee on Zoning, Landmarks and Building Standards
                                                                                    City Council 2.24.21
                                                  Committee on Zoning, Landmarks, & Building Standards




                                   ORDINANCE


B E IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:


SECTION 1. Title 17 ofthe Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning
Ordinance, is hereby amended by changing all of the M2-3, Light Industry District
symbols and indications as shown on Map No 6-1 in the area bounded by

       the northwesterly line ofthe abandoned INRY right-of-way; South Troy Street; a
       line 264 feet north of and parallel to West 30th Street; and the alley next west of
       and parallel to South Troy Street and the centerline of said alley where no alley
       exists


to those of a Ml-1, Limited Manufacturing/Business Park District


SECTION 2. This ordinance takes effect after its passage and approval.




                                             George Cardenas
                                             Alderman, 12th Ward




Common Address:
2800-30 S Troy St
